label: Contradiction-7
title: K-007: How severe: CVSS 10.0, 9.2 or 9.8?
description: 10.0 was wrong. 9.2 and 9.8 are both right, on two different scales scored by two different parties, and they disagree on one input: the vendor says attack complexity is high, NIST says low. The site explains 10.0 against 9.2 but never mentions 9.8, which is what a reader checking NVD, or a scanner reporting CVSS 3.1, will see.
